title: Swords & Swearing Modpack
description:
A VanillaPlus modpack which adds ability to move spawners and villagers, create new items, remove or transfer enchantments, summon  companions, and adds new crops and cooking recipes. 

Also adds some performance, QoL and world generation changes.
body:
A modpack for friends playing on a private, Vanilla+ whitelisted server.
These mods will allow players to pick up & place down spawners, summon pets and mounts, create new items (tiered backpacks as well as amethyst tools & armor), pick up & move villagers as well as reset villager trades, and removes some enchantment incompatabilities and allows for transfering enchantments. Three mods affect world generation: Geophilic – Vanilla Biome Overhauls adds some custom biomes and tweaks many biomes for more visual variety, Farmer's Delight introduces new crops & recipes, and Towns & Towers will introduce new structures & improved towns to world gen.

There are also some QoL mods to increase stack sizes, improve server performance with XP, add teleport & home functionaly, prevent item despawn on death, and teleport mounts with you when you tp.


It includes the following mods - all credit & rights belong to the mod authors:

- Amethyst Tools & More
- Call of Companions ( https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/call-of-companions )
- Eggify
- Enchantment Transferring
- Farmer's Delight Refabricated
- Geophilic – Vanilla Biome Overhauls
- GetSpawners
- Grind enchantments
- Improved Happy Ghast
- Just Enough Items (JEI)
- LambDynamicLights
- Mooshroom Tweaks
- No Creeper Griefing
- Portable Villager
- Sails and Airships
- Script's Chunk Loaders
- Stackable127
- Tiered Backpacks
- Towns and Towers
- TpWithMe
- Trade Cycling
- Universal Enchants
- VeinMiner

- Xaero’s Minimap
- Xaero’s World Map

Included Dependencies/Libraries:
- Fabric API
- Fabric Language Kotlin
- Cloth Config API (Fabric/Forge/NeoForge)
- Collective
- Cristel Lib
- Forge Config API Port
- Fzzy Config
- Mod Menu
- Puzzles Lib
- Text Placeholder API


Big thanks to all the mod authors for their hard work.
